questions.question: Select the correct reported speech form: 'She said, 'I am studying English at the moment.''
options: She said she was studying English at that time.
She said she studies English now.
She said she is studying English.
She said she had been studying English.
questions.answer: She said she was studying English at that time.

questions.question: Which sentence correctly reports the following direct speech? 'If I had known about the meeting, I would have attended it.'
options: He said that if he had known about the meeting, he would have attended it.
He said that if he knew about the meeting, he would attend it.
He said that if he had known about the meeting, he would attend it.
He said that if he knew about the meeting, he would have attended it.
questions.answer: He said that if he had known about the meeting, he would have attended it.

The teacher said that the Earth revolves around the Sun.

The teacher said that the Earth had revolved around the Sun.
questions.answer: The teacher said that the Earth revolves around the Sun.
